title: Implement remaining movement primitives
description: Only step/slide/leap/hop are implemented for move generation. Implement the remaining primitives: draw (take from stack), move_to/transfer (between zones), swap, remove (as movement trigger), promote (with choice), castle (composite king+rook), flip (as movement trigger). Also implement hand plays (generate_hand_plays is currently a no-op stub). Both Rust and Python engines.
close_reason: Implemented remove, swap, promote, draw transitions + flip/remove/swap move generation in both Rust and Python. Castle and move_to deferred to follow-up (multi-piece coordination, cross-zone transfer).
